item.beatlamp.beat_lamp.tooltip.summary: Audio-reactive neon lamp with 9 visualizer modes.
item.beatlamp.beat_lamp.tooltip.details:
• 9 Modes: VU Meter, Waveform, Matrix, RGB...
• Realtime audio frequency visualizer
• Link multiple lamps with Group Linker
• Right-click with Controller to configure
item.beatlamp.stage_light.tooltip.detail:
• Moving-head concert beam (up to 34 blocks)
• 5 Modes: Sweep, Beat Step, Static, Strobe, Chase
• Right-click with Controller to adjust angle & speed
item.beatlamp.laser_projector.tooltip.de:
• 1 to 8 high-energy neon lasers
• 4 Modes: Fan Sweep, Cone Spin, Static, Burst
• Adjustable spread (10°-120°) and speed
• Right-click with Controller to configure
item.beatlamp.fog_generator.tooltip.summ: Low-lying dry-ice stage fog & CO2 jet blast.
item.beatlamp.fog_generator.tooltip.deta:
• Low-lying dry-ice floor fog (4-16 blocks)
• Automatic CO2 jet blasts on beat drops
• Supports all 6 directional angles
• Right-click with Controller to configure
item.beatlamp.fountain.tooltip.details:
• Pyro spark fountain & fireworks launcher
• Independent spray & impact drop thresholds
• 7 particle types (Flame, Glow, Spark...)
• Right-click with Controller to configure
item.beatlamp.beat_emitter.tooltip.summa: Converts music beats into Redstone signals.
item.beatlamp.beat_emitter.tooltip.detai:
• Converts music beats into Redstone pulses
• 1-tick clock pulse or analog signal (0-15)
• Sneak + Right Click to cycle target source
item.beatlamp.stage_jukebox.tooltip.summ: Modern titanium jukebox for stage performances.
item.beatlamp.stage_jukebox.tooltip.deta:
• Titanium jukebox with DSP beat tracking
• Obsidian chassis with neon indicator LEDs
• Fully compatible with vanilla music discs
item.beatlamp.dmx_console.tooltip.summar: Master lighting control desk for stage productions.
item.beatlamp.dmx_console.tooltip.detail:
• Master lighting desk (Decoration)
• OLED waveform monitor & tactile faders
item.beatlamp.dj_deck.tooltip.details:
• Professional DJ deck (Decoration)
• Dual jog wheels & RGB performance pads
item.beatlamp.stage_speaker.tooltip.summ: High-power line array concert speaker cabinet.
item.beatlamp.stage_speaker.tooltip.deta:
• Concert line array speaker (Decoration)
• Heavy wooden cabinet, stackable vertically
item.beatlamp.linker.tooltip.details:
• Click 1st corner to select device type
• Click 2nd corner to link matching devices
• Sneak + Right Click anywhere to cancel
item.beatlamp.controller.tooltip.summary: Universal stage remote controller & jukebox binder.
item.beatlamp.controller.tooltip.details:
• Right-click any stage device to open settings
• Sneak + Right Click Jukebox to select source
• Right-click devices with source to bind
message.beatlamp.mode.wave: Mode: Wave (wave runs along the row)
message.beatlamp.mode.scan: Mode: Scan (light sweeps back and forth)
message.beatlamp.link.anchor: Corner set - click opposite corner to link all matching devices in the area (sneak-click to cancel)
message.beatlamp.link.invalid_start: Selection must start on a stage device (Beat Lamp, Stage Light, Fountain, Laser, Fog, or Emitter)
message.beatlamp.link.full: Too many devices in the area (max %s), cannot link
message.beatlamp.link.empty: No matching stage devices found in the selected area
message.beatlamp.source.selected: Jukebox selected! Right-click any stage device to bind audio source
message.beatlamp.emitter.mode.pulse: Emitter mode: Beat Pulse Clock (1-tick spike on drop)
